corrections.old_text: ዘፀ ፲፯ ፲፪ ዘሌዋ ፲፪ ፫ ማቴ ፩
corrections.corrected_text: ዘፍ ፲፯ ፲፪ ዘሌዋ ፲፪ ፫ ማቴ ፩
corrections.reason: The cross-reference for eighth-day circumcision is Genesis 17:12 (ዘፍ ፲፯ ፲፪); the rounded loop of ፍ was misread as ፀ.
The word-divider colon (፡) between አለ and ጌታ bled slightly, causing Stage 1 to misread አለ፡ጌታ ('it said; [whereas for] the Lord...') as እለነጌታ.
